title: Deliver Diamonds to Mundhattan Ridge Bank
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Diamonds** delivered to **Mundhattan Ridge Bank** (industry id 33, near tile 41,196).

A likely supplier is **Wrenninghead Diamond Mine** (industry id 62, near tile 65,198); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **16,000 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
